RMM evaluation and operations templates.

Turn endpoint exceptions, network-monitoring acceptance, service desk escalation, RMM script-job evidence, agent performance and upgrade failures, offline-agent and duplicate-device troubleshooting, repair decisions, allowlisting, backup restore tests, MSP QBRs, API integrations, requirements, security and audit evidence, vendor exits, quotes, alert measurements, service commitments, access reviews, client lifecycle work, endpoint changes, migrations, and incidents into owned, reviewable records. All forty-one templates are plain CSV files—no account, email address, or product installation required.

Separate authorization, endpoint, support-service, network, relay, session, display, and security-control failures before unsafe workarounds or broad retries.

  • Preserve the failed session and authorization evidence

  • Retest one bounded session and verify clean termination
